functionalRequirement.description: Each category maps to one predefined background asset. All word pairs in the same category use that background. The background must remain legible behind the prompt, hints, answer field, and scorecard. The initial six category illustrations use cel-shaded comic panels; gameplay content rests on a readable frosted translucent panel. Artwork fills the page background, not a separate artwork panel. Each category provides 9:16 and 16:9 compositions selected by viewport orientation.
